items.headline: Veeva Systems announced fiscal 2027 first-quarter results on June 3, 2026, which is within the last 48 hours only if measured from June 5, 2026; however, based on the provided sources, the release itself is the key material item tied to recent earnings.

Veeva also announced Falcon, an agentic labor product for drug development, and customer commitments to Veeva Vault CRM and Safety Suite, but the provided source does not show publication timestamps within the last 48 hours.
